I spent most of the morning on the streaming change. The server now transcribes while you are still talking, so the text is ready about five milliseconds after you stop, instead of two hundred and twenty. The catch is that the first chunk has to wait for the model to warm up, which takes about a second on a cold start. I tried keeping the model loaded between sessions and that fixes it, but it costs around two gigabytes of video memory, so I made it a setting and left it on by default. Next I want to look at the overlay, because it still flickers when the waveform resets, and I want to make the error chime a bit quieter.
